name: Auto-Sprint Mod
teaser: Auto-run, manage stamina smartly, jump obstacles, and access inventory - all on the go.
description_html:
SPT Auto-Sprint Mod

This mod introduces an auto-sprint feature to enhance gameplay in SPT. With this mod, your character can automatically walk or sprint at the press of a button or combination. The sprint function intelligently manages stamina: sprinting stops when stamina reaches the red zone to prevent exhaustion and resumes automatically once fully recovered (if recoverable while walking).

By default, activate cruise mode by double-tapping the “walk forward” button. It will deactivate when you press any movement button. You can control sprinting by your sprint button

Additional features:

- Automatic obstacle jumping/vaulting for seamless movement.

- Access to inventory while sprinting, allowing for uninterrupted gameplay.

Available settings:

Installation:

Download the mod .ZIP file and extract .dll to /BepInEx/plugins in your SPT installation directory.

This is my first mod, and I’m open to feedback and suggestions for improvements! Feel free to share your ideas.
